title: Anatomy of a Smile
concept: Dental imagery shot like a luxury product ad — extreme macro, water, glass, light, polished steel. No faces until the final beat, which removes all uncanny-valley risk and lets the realism go as far as it can. This is the 'things the average person doesn't think to make a video of' angle: nobody expects a dental practice to look like a perfume commercial. Doubles as a portfolio piece for Montero. 9:16, no dialogue.

audio.music: Sparse ambient pad, single sustained tone, slow build. Feels expensive, not clinical.
audio.sfx: Designed and deliberate: a single water droplet impact, the soft ring of steel set on steel, a breath of air, a faint high shimmer on the light-through-water frame. Silence between each — the gaps are the point.

frames.story: A single water droplet hits a surface in extreme slow motion. Pure texture, no context yet.
frames.image_prompt: Extreme macro photograph of one water droplet striking a wet polished white ceramic surface, frozen at the instant of impact with a perfect crown of micro-droplets rising from it. Cool daylight from a large soft source above, deep black background falling off behind. Visible surface tension, tiny bubbles, a faint mineral speckle on the ceramic. Shot on a 100mm macro lens at f8, focus-stacked, natural colour. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Very slow motion, the crown rising and collapsing back into a ripple. Camera perfectly still. Audio: one clean droplet impact, then silence.

frames.story: Instruments laid out like fine jewellery — brushed steel, precise spacing, shallow focus.
frames.image_prompt: Overhead macro photograph of three stainless steel dental instruments laid in precise parallel on a matte charcoal linen cloth, spaced like watchmaker's tools. Brushed metal grain visible along each handle, one instrument catching a long specular highlight, the others falling into soft focus. Single large softbox from the upper left, deep shadow to the right. Shot on a 100mm macro at f2.8, shallow depth of field, no props, no clutter. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Slow lateral drift right to left, the specular highlight travelling along the steel as the camera moves. Audio: soft ring of steel touching steel, then quiet.

frames.story: Light through water through glass — abstract, cool, unmistakably clean.
frames.image_prompt: Macro photograph looking through a plain glass tumbler of still water on a white surface, hard backlight refracting through the water into a clean caustic pattern of light on the surface behind it. Condensation beads on the outside of the glass, one slow bead beginning to run. Cool blue-white light, deep clean whites, no colour cast. Shot on a 100mm macro at f5.6, natural refraction, no filters. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: The condensation bead runs slowly down the glass; the caustic light pattern shifts and breathes as the water settles. Audio: faint high shimmer.

frames.story: The first human beat: a real, unposed smile in warm light. Everything cold turns warm.
frames.image_prompt: Close-up candid photograph of a woman in her thirties mid-laugh, looking slightly off camera, natural teeth, no makeup styling, fine skin texture and a few freckles visible. Warm late-afternoon window light from the left, soft shadow on the right side of her face, plain out-of-focus interior behind her. Unposed, caught between expressions, genuine crinkle at the eyes. Shot on an 85mm lens at f1.8, natural light only, fine grain. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: The laugh continues and softens; she glances toward camera at the very end. Slight handheld drift. Audio: warm ambience arrives, music opens up.

frames.image_prompt: Minimal end card on a deep charcoal background with an extremely subtle vertical gradient. Centered text in a refined light-weight serif reading exactly: "Care worth showing off." Below it, small and widely letter-spaced in a clean sans serif: SMILE FAMILY DENTAL CARE — UNION, NJ. Nothing else in frame, very generous margins, faint film grain. Vertical composition.
frames.motion_prompt: Type fades up slowly, grain shimmering, gradient breathing once. Audio: single sustained tone resolving to silence.
